options.label: Assumed detour reserve
options.detail: Illustrative indexed capacity and costs; individual recovery is not additive with other options

options.label: Assumed expedited reserve
options.detail: Illustrative indexed capacity and costs; individual recovery is not additive with other options

options.label: Assumed alternate supply
options.detail: Illustrative indexed capacity and costs; individual recovery is not additive with other options

quota.recoverySentence: Median indexed plan reaches the assumed weekly target from week 4
quota.unit: indexed demand units; 100 is an assumed weekly reference, not a count of devices
quota.scope: Illustrative indexed planning exercise; not estimated Apple production, shipping capacity, or actual procurement cost

sensitivity.label: Time for regular capacity to recover
Assumed detour reserve: time to start
Assumed detour reserve: time to reach full capacity
Assumed expedited reserve: cost per indexed unit
Assumed alternate supply: time to reach full capacity
Assumed alternate supply: time to start
Assumed detour reserve: cost per indexed unit
Assumed expedited reserve: time to start
Assumed expedited reserve: time to reach full capacity
Assumed alternate supply: cost per indexed unit

outcomeDefinition: Company market-model CAR over trading days 0 to +10; hit when t < -1.96. Not a measurement of factory damage or production loss.
unknowns: Apple revenue at risk and delayed share
dateBasis: Mainshock local Japan date; USGS UTC time is April 15 at 16:25

cohort.yearBasis: Explicit 2016 procurement coverage; fiscal-year basis is not stated

optimization.scope: Illustrative indexed planning exercise; not estimated Apple production, shipping capacity, or actual procurement cost

inputRanges.scope: Illustrative indexed planning exercise; not estimated Apple production, shipping capacity, or actual procurement cost
inputRanges.unit: indexed demand units; 100 is an assumed weekly reference, not a count of devices
inputRanges.distribution: independent uniform over each stated range; sampled once per scenario draw and shared across option combinations

approval.decision: Approve illustrative M9 model and ranges
approval.basis: Explicit user reply to the M9 method and range proposal

optimization.rangeDefinition: 2.5th/97.5th percentiles of independent uniform input draws; not empirically calibrated confidence bounds
optimization.sensitivityDefinition: Spearman correlation with cumulative unmet indexed demand in the default plan; positive means more shortage
optimization.costDefinition: Hypothetical incremental USD per indexed unit; no mapping to Apple units or revenue

affectedRoutesBasis: Scenario exposure overlay inferred from sourced disruption geography and reference corridors. 'Blocked' marks potential disrupted access, not proof that each gateway shut or an Apple shipment stopped. Detour and expedited routes are hypothetical alternatives; no capacity, availability, legality or realized rerouting is measured.
affectedRoutesScope: Display-only; not inputs to the CAR model or to the independent approved indexed optimizer
